tag: TAG fable-porter PT-38 S21 bill census (bill_census_layers.py + census_S21_report.py)
note: net 35 cold (first in the process), net 100 warm (second); 1 U = 2*1024^3 flops = one dense 1024^3 product

push_young.desc: young CP columns pushed through W: _push_bank_shared_newborn inherited = W^T p_young (n x live x young)

push_newborn.desc: previous layer's births pushed: common = W^T base[:, selected] (n x live x births) + column assembly

push_old_basis.desc: old tier: its rank-384 basis pushed, U = W^T Q (n x live x 384; fixed size once the tier exists)

old_reconstruct.desc: old tier: all old columns rebuilt explicitly, old = U F (n x 384 x old_cols)

join.desc: old-tier join/recompress at L8/L11/L14 (sketch Y, QR, factors, weighted cores)

push_assembly.desc: push bookkeeping: deadcut row gather/scatter, old|young concatenate, Qp gather

read_young.desc: young read: (pp^2)[resp rows] @ (right*lam)^T over young columns (n_resp x young x n_live)

read_old.desc: old read: inner = (pp^2)_old @ (F lam)^T (x old_cols x 384) + old plane = inner @ pre_basis^T

read_prep.desc: read-side elementwise over columns: pp^2, pp^3*lam, row sums, gathers, plane put; L15 bank diagonal cube

column_bookkeeping.desc: newborn tuple gather, gated young columns p, old-tier commit, lam concatenate

covariance.desc: W^T C W: L0 Gram, half of the batched pair (C W), _sym_upper second product, L15 variance diagonal

star_lowrank.desc: star transport, low-rank: _lr_factor (sketch, 1 power step, small SVD), P1/pushed/s2 skinny products, half of the batched pair (pw W), L15 star diagonal

planes_K21_K22.desc: K21 plane assembly (cp + star + outer terms), k4, VV, CC = Cpre^2, K22 plane

gnn.desc: GNN mean head (hook) + recentering C -= m dm^T ...

births_planes.desc: birth planes (n^2): inherited, bp, trace_post, born, _bd_update (4 legs), cp_post

star_formation.desc: rest = target - cp_post - trace_post; star = 3 rest^T - 2 diag

final_map.desc: L15 scalar map + final GNN hook

misc.desc: everything else (mu, bpre, gates, selects, live outer, casts, W5 port begin/end)

notes: 1 U = 2*1024^3 flops (one dense 1024^3 f32 product as flopscope bills it); net 35 cold, net 100 warm; fired S21 eddbcfcd
cols_in/old_cols/young_cols = state at the layer's FIRST op (after layer l-1); *_during = in-layer values (joins happen inside the push of L7/L10/L13)
births = units born at layer l (each adds 2 CP columns: +/- legs); newborn push at layer l carries the births of layer l-1
the batched pair [(C32,W),(pw,W)] in _flms_cov_star is split 50/50 between covariance and star_lowrank (two equal 1024^3 products)
L15: the final layer pushes all bank columns again (young push + old reconstruct) for the k3 diagonal on the row-cut rows (L15_bank_U)
